prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 高一学生期中期末成绩汇总 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "姓名" spans 1 col × 2 row; "语文" spans 2 col × 1 row; "数学" spans 2 col × 1 row; "英语" spans 2 col × 1 row; "总分" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "语文 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "语文 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "数学 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "数学 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 6: header "英语 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 7: header "英语 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 8: header "总分" · longest unbreakable word 28px · one-line width 31px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 432px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 431px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

The image shows the table's content with every cell on one line, so you can read everything. Study it first.
1) Understand it: what is the table for, how will people read, scan and compare it, which columns play the same or similar role, which values must stay intact, which text may wrap naturally, and where existing row height could absorb wrapping.
2) Propose 3 genuinely different column-width designs for 432px (different strategies, not small variations).
Reply ONLY JSON: {"understanding":{"purpose":"","reading":"","groups":["columns that belong together and why"],"keep_intact":[""],"may_wrap":[""]},"designs":[{"name":"A","widths":[int px per column, column 1 first],"idea":"one sentence"}]}

log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"汇总六名高一学生的期中、期末各科成绩及总分，便于查看个人表现和比较学生之间的成绩。","reading":"按行查看每名学生的各科成绩与总分；按列比较不同学生，并在同一学科内比较期中与期末。","groups":["姓名是行标识，应与该行成绩保持清晰关联。","语文、数学、英语各自的期中和期末列构成一组；六列作用相同，适合采用一致的宽度。","总分是每行的综合结果，应便于单独定位和跨行比较。"],"keep_intact":["两位数成绩和三位数总分应保持在同一行。","学生姓名宜保持完整，以便快速识别行。"],"may_wrap":["空间不足时，姓名可在汉字之间换行，但会增加数据行高度并削弱快速识别。","期中、期末可在汉字之间换行；表头已有两层，增加表头高度可避免压缩数据行。"]},"designs":[{"name":"A","widths":[67,52,52,52,52,52,52,52],"idea":"姓名、各次成绩和总分均保持单行，六个成绩列等宽，适合紧凑地逐行和逐列比较。"},{"name":"B","widths":[52,54,54,54,54,54,54,55],"idea":"收窄姓名列并让姓名换行，为六个同类成绩列和总分列提供更多空间。"},{"name":"C","widths":[67,49,49,49,49,49,49,70],"idea":"保留完整姓名并突出总分，通过让期中、期末表头换行来压缩六个等宽成绩列。"}]}
